title: Yarik LLM Bot
description: Your group chat hits a question nobody can settle. Copying the conversation into a separate LLM chat breaks the flow. Yarik brings an LLM into the group as a chat member, so you can ask, argue, and work things out together, right where the conversation is happening.
availability: Yarik is in closed testing. The bot is publicly accessible, but I’m keeping the test chat link off the portfolio for now. Integrations with popular chat platforms are planned.

title: Fullstack Starter
description: Every new web app needs sign-in, access control, and a place to manage it. Fullstack Starter puts those pieces in a Kotlin and Next.js template, so you can start building your actual idea instead of setting them up again.
availability: The live site shows the sign-in flow. Console access requires approval; the screenshots show the included admin tools.

title: GenTool Data Viewer
description: Find a Zero Hour replay without digging through GenTool folders. Search and sort matches, jump from a player to their replay history, and open replay files in a few clicks. Player aliases and linked Discord accounts help identify opponents, while sortable stats and CPU benchmark scores help you spot weaker hardware before a match and avoid slow games.
availability: Browse player and replay data on the live site. Discord sign-in enables player linking and rescan requests. These screenshots use fictional data.
